prompts.rat: Use case: game-asset. Asset type: production pixel-art animation spritesheet with TRUE transparent background. Create a 1024 by 1536 sheet in EXACT 4 columns and 8 rows, 32 separate equal 256x192 cells. Each cell contains the SAME realistic small brown-grey medieval street rat WITHOUT A TAIL (tail will be articulated separately in game). A slender anatomically credible rat, hunched haunches, pointed nose, small pink ears and pink paws, dark glossy eyes, detailed clustered pixel-art fur, warm grey brown highlights and charcoal shadows. Not cartoon, not mouse, not fluffy squirrel. Orthographic isometric view, camera elevated 30 degrees, no perspective. Whole animal fits in each cell with generous transparent margins, centered near x128 y105. FOUR columns are four successive walking footfall poses, consistent body size and placement and direction across row, subtle body motion. EIGHT rows are exact different SCREEN directions: row1 nose RIGHT; row2 nose LOWER RIGHT; row3 nose DOWN toward camera; row4 nose LOWER LEFT; row5 nose LEFT; row6 nose UPPER LEFT away; row7 nose UP away from camera; row8 nose UPPER RIGHT. This must be a directional turntable, back views must show back of head. Body should occupy about 150px wide for side views, maintain physical body size for front/back. Flat soft neutral lighting for reuse, crisp visible pixel clusters, no shadows on ground, no scenery, NO TAIL at all, no grid or text. True alpha.
prompts.floor: Use case: game-asset. Create a square seamless tiling material texture, straight overhead orthographic flat view, of medieval wet brick cobblestone road. Beautiful hand-placed pixel art with crisp 2 to 4 pixel clusters. Small irregular rectangular dark slate blue grey and muted charcoal brown setts, offset courses, mortar cracks, occasional tiny olive moss, subtle rain worn reflective edges. Realistic archaeological stone material translated into detailed pixel art, subdued somber night palette but readable midtones, no black voids. Even ambient lighting, no directional cast shadows. Tiles fill ENTIRE 1024x1024 image edge to edge. Each paving block roughly 90x48 pixels. Edges tile seamlessly. No perspective, no objects, no walls, no plants except moss, no borders, no text. This will be projected into an isometric plane in WebGL.
prompts.wall: Use case: game-asset. Create a square seamless tiling material texture, front-on orthographic flat view, of a medieval castle's lower limestone wall. Beautiful detailed pixel art, crisp 2 to 4 pixel clusters. Large uneven rectangular ashlar stone blocks in offset horizontal courses, pitted weathered grey warm taupe stone, dark recessed joints, subtle dark moss along joints. Somber moonlit desaturated blue-grey shadows with neutral stone midtones. Realistic tactile stone translated to pixel art. Blocks about 220 pixels wide by 120 high. Surface fills entire 1024x1024 image edge to edge, seamless tiling across edges. Even lighting, no cast shadows, no sky, no floor, no doors, no objects, no perspective, no letters or borders. This texture will cover actual isometric wall geometry in a close-up nighttime street scene.
